title: The First Manifestation of the Shackle Power
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought the outcome was decided, in the depths of the repelled Heavenly Eye projection, a gaze beyond the limits of perception slowly opened——that was the omen of the true form about to descend.

text.content:
The air deep within the ruins seemed to have solidified into substance. Chen Ji stood before the mural, the ink-colored patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment behind him vibrating at an eerie frequency——this was a power fluctuation he had never felt before—not from himself, but from some existence sealed deep within the Tianji Record.

Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows, her eyes carrying the same exhaustion as Chen Ji, yet when she looked at the truth reflected in the mural, a moment of understanding flashed across her face.

"Chen Ji, you've finally discovered it." Her voice was hoarse, "The Shackle Power... it is not a gift, it is a loan."

Chen Ji did not respond to Ye Qing's words, because his entire attention was drawn to the consciousness condensing within the mural. The Heavenly Eye's pressure was like a materialized mountain range, crushing his soul inch by inch, and at this critical moment, he felt the seal deep within the Tianji Record loosen——that was the "Shackle Power" that Mo Xiansheng had once mentioned.

The cost was burning Heavenly Fate Value.

But at this moment, he had no choice.

dialogue.content:
"Ant, you think that glimpsing a corner of the truth gives you the qualification to resist?" The Heavenly Eye's voice came from deep within the mural, carrying a coldness that transcended emotion, "Every prophet throughout history has been so arrogant. Their endings, you should be well aware of."

A faint smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, that smile appearing particularly sharp under the pressure: "Very much so. Which is why I say——your kind, these lofty existences, your biggest flaw is looking down on ants."

He forcefully activated the Tianji Record Fragment, and the ink-colored patterns on the fragment suddenly burst into dazzling light. A power several times beyond his current realm gushed out from the depths of the fragment, like an ancient fierce beast breaking free from its cage, carrying an earth-shattering momentum, rushing directly toward the Heavenly Eye's projection.

text.content:
The Shackle Power was a forbidden power contained within the Tianji Record.

It was not merely strength, but a "contract"——using Heavenly Fate Value as chains, temporarily borrowing the power exploited from generations of prophets within the Tianji Record, releasing it at critical moments.

Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value depleting at an alarming rate: 5 points, 10 points, 20 points... but he showed no hesitation, because in the instant that power surged forth, he saw something unprecedented in the Heavenly Eye projection's pupil—something called "astonishment."

It was an expression he had never seen on any being's face.

"BOOM——!"

The Shackle Power transformed into a pitch-black chain, penetrating the ruins' layers of prohibitions, striking directly at the core of the Heavenly Eye's projection. That projection violently trembled, as if slapped hard by an invisible giant hand.

In the passage on the other side of the ruins, Han Lie was leading elite disciples from the Xuanwu Sect forward with difficulty. He had thought himself the biggest beneficiary of this exploration——after all, that ancient elixir he had unexpectedly obtained had allowed him to break through his long-troubling bottleneck.

However, just now, he had felt two presences sufficient to make his soul tremble.

One was that indescribable Heavenly Eye, and the other... had actually erupted from that waste servant disciple he had never even bothered to look at directly.

"This is impossible!" Han Lie's roar echoed through the passage, "That waste, how could he——"

Before he could finish, a虚影 of a pitch-black chain pierced through the ruins' dome, accompanied by the Heavenly Eye projection's first genuine pained cry, that chain precisely striking the core of that giant eye.

Han Lie saw it.

He saw the Heavenly Eye's projection——that existence even he could not look directly at——actually being beaten back by that waste disciple.

dialogue.content:
"No... this is absolutely impossible!" Han Lie's face was filled with disbelief, he shoved aside the junior brother beside him and stumbled toward the direction of the pressure, "Chen Ji! That waste Chen Ji! Get out here for me!"

His voice carried a subtle tremor, that instinctive fear when one's authority is challenged.

At this moment, in the ruins' hall, Chen Ji had one hand behind his back, his robes rustling in the wind. After the Heavenly Eye's projection was repelled by the Shackle Power, that giant eye's light had noticeably dimmed, and the surrounding pressure had also lessened.

He slowly turned his head, his gaze passing through layers of stone pillars, landing on Han Lie rushing out from the passage, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his mouth.

"Senior Brother Han," Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "So anxious, have you come to congratulate me?"

text.content:
Han Lie shuddered throughout, those eyes that would usually only see cowardice and fear when looking at Chen Ji now faced a pair of bottomless depths. There was no anger in those eyes, no fear, only a kind of cold indifference that made his spine crawl.

As if he, Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, was merely a noisy mosquito in the other's eyes.

"You... what kind of monster are you?" Han Lie下意识地 retreated a step, his voice turning sharp, "You've been hiding your true abilities all along! You've been deceiving us all!"

Chen Ji sighed lightly, that sigh carrying a trace of sincere helplessness: "Senior Brother Han, what have I deceived you about? I'm just a servant disciple, a bit slower in cultivation, a bit lower in Combat Power, these are well-known facts."

He paused, his gaze sweeping across the other sect disciples who had come with Han Lie: "As for that move just now... that wasn't my power, it was the Tianji Record's. So if you want to blame someone, blame that book."

choice.prompt: Han Lie's questioning made everyone present hold their breath. As the first person to witness the Shackle Power firsthand, Chen Ji's stance at this moment would determine the direction of the upcoming situation.

choices.text: Direct Confrontation——Crushing Han Lie's Prestige on the Spot
choices.description: Taking advantage of Han Lie's wavering heart and mind, using both words and momentum to doubly suppress, humiliating this Xuanwu Sect genius in public, stripping him of all face.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing more strength may attract stronger enemies
choices.visible_reward: All sect disciples present witness Han Lie's humiliation, prestige greatly increased
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie is backed by the entire Xuanwu Sect, offending him means offending a behemoth
choices.process_label: chen ji teaches han lie a lesson

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji walked slowly toward Han Lie, each step seeming to step on the other's heartstrings. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly entered each person's ears: "Senior Brother Han, you say I've been hiding my true abilities?"

He tilted his head, seeming to smile yet not: "Then what about you? Three days ago at Luoxia Valley, when you were being chased by that third-tier demon beast, I saw it with my own eyes. Want me to describe your expression at that time? Very spectacular."

Han Lie's face instantly flushed red: "You're lying!"

"Lying?" Chen Ji took out a jade slip from his sleeve and tossed it gently into the air. The recording within that jade slip was赫然 Han Lie's image of fleeing in desperation, "Is this something I forged as well?"

choices.text: Strategic Retreat——Feigning Weakness While Actually Setting a Trap
choices.description: Deliberately saying some weak-sounding words to make Han Lie relax his guard, while secretly observing everyone's reactions to gather intelligence for subsequent scheming.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily swallowing this anger, unable to feel satisfied on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Concealing true strength, avoiding premature exposure while gaining more intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May make Han Lie even more arrogant, thinking you're easy to bully
choices.process_label: chen ji bides time, observes secretly

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, smiling lightly: "Senior Brother Han is right, I have indeed been hiding my true abilities all along."

His openness made everyone present freeze.

"However," Chen Ji's tone shifted, "isn't hiding one's abilities quite common in the cultivation world? Could it be that Senior Brother Han has never hidden anything?"

He didn't wait for Han Lie's response, continuing on his own: "That force just now was stimulated by the Tianji Record Fragment, the cost was me burning most of my Heavenly Fate Value. Now I'm extremely weak. If Senior Brother Han doesn't believe, you can come forward and verify."

Saying this, he made a precarious gesture, while secretly scanning with his divine sense each person's expression and reaction——who was surprised, who was pondering, who was calculating, he recorded it all in his heart.

text.content:
Deep within the mural, the Heavenly Eye projection injured by the Shackle Power did not dissipate, but reconstituted at an even slower, heavier pace. That giant eye no longer held only coldness, replaced instead by a sinister observation of a hunting prey.

"Interesting." That voice rang out again, this time carrying a trace of genuine interest, "Shackle Power... so those old fellows left behind such a trump card."

Chen Ji felt that oppressive pressure not decreasing but increasing, his Heavenly Fate Value continuously depleting, yet his expression remained calm. Mo Xiansheng had once said, the Heavenly Eye was not an invincible opponent—it was merely one of the most difficult opponents to defeat between heaven and earth.

And "one of" meant there was still a chance.

Ye Qing quietly came to Chen Ji's side, her palm凝聚 a sphere of dark light, that was her "Demonic Path Mist" skill: "Chen Ji, my aura concealment won't hold much longer."

Chen Ji nodded slightly, yet his gaze remained locked on that reopening giant eye within the mural.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji." The Heavenly Eye's voice directly sounded in his mind, that was a transmission of will bypassing all defenses, "Do you think the Shackle Power is your own strength?"

Chen Ji's pupils slightly constricted.

"That is merely residual power fragments from generations of prophets after they were harvested." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a trace of mockery, "Every time you use it, you step closer to becoming the next fragment. This game, from the moment you obtained the Tianji Record, the ending was already predetermined."

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then laughed lightly: "Since the ending is predetermined, then why bother talking nonsense with me?"

He raised his head, staring directly at that giant eye: "You're afraid."

The giant eye within the mural suddenly contracted.

text.content:
While the Heavenly Eye and Chen Ji confronted each other, the atmosphere in the ruins' hall had dropped to freezing point.

Han Lie stared fixedly at Chen Ji. The previous exchange made him realize one thing——this waste servant disciple was far more dangerous than he had imagined. More importantly, he knew about Han Lie's disgrace three days ago. If that recording spread...

"Chen Ji, you wait for me!" Han Lie ground his teeth, yet did not dare to make a move here. The residual force from that Shackle Power still lingered in the air, that oppressive feeling even making this Foundation Building Peak expert feel palpitations.

He turned to leave, yet heard Chen Ji's light voice behind him:

"Senior Brother Han, regarding the origin of that ancient elixir, you're certain you don't need to explain?"

dialogue.content:
Han Lie's footsteps suddenly froze.

He spun around sharply, his expression violently fluctuating between rage and panic: "What did you say? How do you know about the elixir!"

Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile appearing especially sharp in the dim ruins: "Senior Brother Han, although I'm a servant disciple, my eyes still work fine. When you entered the ruins, the ancient elixir's aura was not on you yet. But when you exited, it was so rich the entire Tianqing Sect could smell it. What does that indicate?"

He deliberately paused, looking around at the surprised expressions of the other sect disciples: "It indicates there were treasures hidden in these ruins to begin with, and Senior Brother Han... helped yourself without invitation?"

"You slander!" Han Lie erupted in rage, "I found it myself!"

"Is that so?" Chen Ji asked lightly, "Then would you dare let everyone present verify whether that ancient elixir has traces of this ruins' unique formation restrictions?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's words put Han Lie in a dilemma. If he accepted the verification, the source of the ancient elixir would inevitably be exposed; if he didn't, what would everyone present think of him? Just as everyone held their breath in anticipation, a strange vibration came from deep within the mural—the true form of the Heavenly Eye seemed about to manifest.

choices.description: Continue to Pressure, Force Han Lie to Publicly Admit the Illicit Origin of the Ancient Elixir, Firmly Grasp His Weakness.

text.content:
Chen Ji stepped forward, his voice clear and resonant: "Fellow brothers and sisters, I won't hide the truth—our Tianqing Sect's expedition to explore the ruins was originally a joint operation involving three parties, with the purpose of finding an ancient cultivation technique. However, Brother Han broke away from the team midway, ventured alone into the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, and took this ancient elixir of unknown origin—"

"Enough!" Han Lie roared, slapping his palm toward Chen Ji.

Yet before his palm wind could reach three feet of Chen Ji, it was blocked by a layer of shadowy light—Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist.

"Is Brother Han trying to silence a witness?" Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of surprise, "Everyone is watching, after all."

The surrounding sect disciples had already begun murmuring among themselves. Han Lie's face had turned as black as a wok.

choices.text: Know When to Stop—Preserve Strength to Face the Imminent Crisis
choices.description: Withdraw at the Right Moment, Point Out Han Lie's Weakness Without Overdoing It, Keep This Card in Reserve for Future Use, While Preparing to Face the Heavenly Eye's True Form's Descent.
choices.visible_cost: Han Lie May Use This to Counterattack and Salvage His Reputation
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the Leverage; Maintain Low-Profile Persona to Avoid Suspicion; Preserve Strength to Face the Crisis
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie Recovers, He May Collude with Others to Target You in the Ruins

text.content:
Just as the atmosphere grew tense enough to snap, a low rumbling sound echoed from deep within the mural, as if some enormous being was awakening.

Chen Ji's brow furrowed as he looked up at the mural. The Heavenly Eye's projection, wounded by the Chains' power, was trembling violently. Cracks of pitch-black darkness began appearing in the surrounding void.

"The Heavenly Eye's true form is about to descend." Ye Qing's voice rang in Chen Ji's ear, tinged with urgency, "We must leave here quickly."

Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then turned to look at Han Lie, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Brother Han, today's matter will be remembered. That ancient elixir—I advise you to return it to the ruins soon. Otherwise, if something goes wrong later, don't blame me for not warning you."

With that, he exchanged a glance with Ye Qing, and both of them darted toward the ruins' exit.

The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out once more, this time carrying an unprecedented gravity:

"Chen Ji, that strike of yours did indeed surprise me. But it has also made me even more certain of one thing—"

The cracks on the mural grew larger and larger, and a pressure beyond the limits of perception was seeping through from the fissures.

"The Tianji Record chose you, not because of your talent, not because of your hard work, but because... you are most suitable to become the next fragment."

Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly.

"Among the prophets throughout history, there have been those of stunning brilliance, but they all failed. And you—" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of playfulness, "Your greatest advantage is that you are weak enough. Weak enough that no one will guard against you, weak enough that even the trajectory of heavenly providence can be misled by you."

"This is why you were chosen."

Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: "So?"

dialogue.content:
"'So'?'" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of laughter, "So you have two choices."

"First, submit to me now. I can give you everything you desire—power, status, immortality. You will become my spokesperson in this world, enjoying the reverence of the masses."

"Second, continue to resist. But I must remind you, you've already experienced the price of the Chains' power. Each time you use it, you draw one step closer to death. And I..."

The massive eye's radiance suddenly surged, and a devastating pressure crashed down:

"I have plenty of time."

Chen Ji looked around and noticed Ye Qing staring at him intently, her eyes filled with worry and trust. In the distance, Han Lie and other sect disciples watched him with complex expressions—reverence, wariness, fear.

He took a deep breath, then smiled.

"I'm quite interested in your first choice." His voice was unexpectedly calm, "But I'd like to know your third choice—say, the option where I completely seal you here right now?"

text.content:
The Heavenly Eye fell silent.

That silence lasted only an instant, but it was enough for Chen Ji to捕捉到 something—not anger, not contempt, but an extremely faint... wariness.

It was wary of him.

This discovery made Chen Ji's heart stir. He knew the Heavenly Eye was an existence beyond the mortal realm, never considering any mortal worth its attention. But now, it was actually wary of him—or rather, it was wary of some possibility within him that had not yet fully awakened.

Mo Xiansheng had once said that the secrets of the Tianji Record went far beyond what was visible on the surface. With each page he deciphered, Chen Ji would gain more truth.

And now, he had faintly touched the edge of that truth.

The Heavenly Eye was not invincible. It too had weaknesses, had fears.

And its weakness might be hidden within—

"Chen Ji!" Ye Qing's cry of alarm broke his thoughts, "It's splitting!"

Chen Ji猛地抬头，只见壁画上的巨眼正在以肉眼可见的速度分裂成数个较小的眼球，每一个都散发着令人心悸的imposing。

这不是投影，而是分身。

天道之眼的主体正在将部分力量投射到遗迹中。分裂出的眼球朝不同方向飞去——有的朝出口，有的朝深处，还有的直冲陈机和夜清而来。

"该死！"陈机低骂，天机录残页上的墨色纹路剧烈颤动。

他必须在短时间内做出选择——继续战斗还是撤退。

就在这时，天机录深处传来墨先生苍老exhausted的声音：

"孩子，枷锁之力不可轻用。但若你执意要战……老朽可以再借你一次。"

"代价是你的fate将再次大幅削减，而且——"墨先生顿了顿，"这可能是最后一次了。"

choice.prompt: Heavenly Eye's Manifestations Approaching, Mo Xiansheng Proposes Final Aid. Chen Ji Must Decide in Limited Time—Fight Desperately or Preserve Strength for Other Opportunities.

choices.text: Desperate Battle—Unleash the Chains' Power Again
choices.description: Accept Mo Xiansheng's Aid, Unleash the Chains' Power Again, Attempt to Annihilate the Heavenly Eye's Manifestations in One Bold Strike, Buy More Breathing Room.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Will Be Significantly Reduced, May Fall into a Weakened State
choices.visible_reward: Annihilate the Heavenly Eye's Manifestations, Temporarily Lift the Crisis; Demonstrate Strength Again Before the Crowd
choices.risk_hint: If Failure Occurs, Will Completely Lose Resistance Ability, at Others' Mercy

text.content:
Chen Ji深吸一口气，做出了决定。

"墨先生，弟子明白了。"他的声音calm而resolute，"既然要战，那就战个痛快！"

天机录残页再次绽放出耀眼的光芒，这一次比之前更加璀璨。枷锁之力如决堤的洪水般倾泻而出，化作无数道漆黑的锁链，朝天道之眼的分身席卷而去。

"轰——！"

那些锁链精准地命中了每一个分身，将它们一一击溃。天道之眼的巨眼发出一声furious的咆哮，那声音中第一次带上了名为"agonized"的情绪。

"陈机！你敢——"

"我有什么不敢的？"陈机的声音中带着几分crazed的笑意，"你不是说要收割我吗？那就来啊！"

他的身体在枷锁之力的反噬下剧烈颤抖，鲜血从嘴角溢出，但他依然死死地站在原地，目光如刀般直视那只巨眼。

choices.text: Strategic Withdrawal—Preserve Strength for Long-Term Planning
choices.description: Reject Mo Xiansheng's proposal, use Ye Qing's Demonic Path fog to conceal their aura, take the opportunity to retreat from the Ancient Forbidden Land, preserving strength for long-term planning.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon the opportunity to defeat the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate; prevent enemies from seeing all of one's trump cards; retreat safely
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie and others might take the opportunity to stab them in the back

text.content:
Chen Ji shook his head and made a completely different choice.

"Mo Xiansheng, the disciple understands. But this is not yet the time to risk our lives." His voice carried a composure beyond his years, "The Heavenly Eye is not an enemy that can be solved in a day or two. I need to preserve my strength."

"Ye Qing!" He turned to the Demonic Path Saint on his side, "How long can your Demonic Path fog conceal our auras?"

Ye Qingwas momentarily stunned，随即明白了他的意图："半柱香的时间，足够我们离开遗迹了。"

"那就走。"陈机当机立断，"墨先生，麻烦您老压制一下那些分身的感知。"

墨先生沉默了片刻，然后发出一声sighing："你这孩子……倒是比历代预言者都要calm。也罢，老朽就再帮你一次。"

一道无形的屏障将陈机和夜清笼罩其中，那些天道之眼的分身顿时失去了目标，在空中crazed地旋转起来。

Chen Ji and Ye Qing's figures quietly departed under the cover of the Demonic Path fog, while the crowd in the ruins hall fell into even greater shock.

Han Lie stared blankly at the direction where Chen Ji had disappeared, his expression infinitely complex. That garbage Servant Disciple he had always looked down upon could actually repel the Heavenly Eye's projection? Actually dared to directly face such a level of existence?

And he had just been questioning and threatening the other party...

A chill crawled from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.

"Han Shixiong," a Xuanwu Sect disciple carefully spoke beside him, "What should we... do?"

Han Lie was silent for a long while, then gritted his teeth and said: "Retreat! Retreat now! This matter must be reported to the sect as soon as possible!"

His voice echoed through the empty ruins, carrying an imperceptible tremor.

And just as they were retreating, deep within the murals, that massive eye gravely wounded by the shackles' power slowly turned. In the depths of its pupil, a gaze beyond the limits of perception suddenly opened—the true form of the Heavenly Eye, crossing through the Void, descending toward this direction.

What Chen Ji did not know was that the true crisis had just begun.
